name: @usdk/host-browser
description: The browser-local execution profile's host: resolves manifests, dynamically imports capability modules (@usdk/loader), constructs the three roles (@usdk/perceive, @usdk/deliberate, @usdk/verify) and @usdk/core, and runs the full conversation turn lifecycle. Approved text is spoken and approved robotics actions execute ONLY through usdk-core's post-commit dispatch gate - see docs/UAGENT_ARCHITECTURE.md 'Ensure external effects pass through the agreement gate.' Accessibility is wired directly, not through the optional-capability loader path, so it never depends on another capability's successful load.
